Figure 2: Architecture of the proposed Pathology-Aware Prototype Distillation (PAPD) module. Patch features are associated with a learnable pathology prototype bank to obtain soft prototype assignments. Teacher and student prototype distributions are aligned through prototype distillation, enabling morphology-aware representation learning by preserving representative tissue patterns during self-supervised training.
